title: Access and verification
description: Configure how long re-authentication stays valid and which methods users may use.
form.section_verification_hint: Controls step-up prompts for sensitive actions such as exports and protected fields.
form.ttl_hours_hint: After a successful password or passkey check, users can perform protected actions for this many hours (1–168).
form.password_enabled_hint: Users can confirm sensitive actions with their account password.
form.passkey_enabled_hint: Users with registered passkeys can confirm actions without typing a password.
form.totp_enabled_hint: Users with 2FA enabled can confirm sensitive actions with an authenticator code.
form.password_login_totp_required_hint: When enabled, users must set up an authenticator before they can sign in with email and password. Passkey and OAuth sign-in are not affected.
error.title: Could not load settings
error.description: Try again or contact an administrator.
